# Data access

The data layer finds scenes and downloads only what is needed, through pygeofetch. These are the functions and classes the
client and the pipelines use.

**Explained in:** [Data guide](../../data/index.md) · [Search and download](../../data/search-and-download.md) · [Providers](../../data/providers.md)

This page documents **28 public classes and functions** in 8 modules.

## `pygeovision.data.reference`

Published reference products, read for a bounding box only.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `copernicus_dem_aws_urls` | function | URLs of the 1-degree Copernicus GLO-30 tiles (AWS Open Data copy) that cover ``bbox`` = (west, south, east, north). |
| `ReferenceDataError` | class | A reference product could not be found or read; the message says what to change. |
| `TargetGrid` | class | A north-up grid in a metric CRS. |
| `utm_crs_for` | function | EPSG code string of the UTM zone containing the point (WGS84). |
| `make_grid` | function | Grid of ``res``-metre pixels covering ``bbox`` (lon/lat), snapped to whole multiples of ``res``. |
| `GridRaster` | class | Pixels of one product on a :class:`TargetGrid`. ``valid`` is False where no source tile had data. |
| `read_to_grid` | function | Read the window of every source that overlaps ``grid`` and mosaic them (first valid pixel wins). |
| `PlanetaryComputer` | class | Minimal STAC search and asset signing for the open Planetary Computer collections. |
| `item_year` | function | Calendar year an annual-product item stands for (``start_datetime`` first, then ``datetime``). |
| `parse_year` | function | ``2021``, ``"2021"``, ``"2021-06"`` or ``"2021-06-30"`` -> 2021. |
